The reply debug accumulator uses the existing HelixAskReply debug contract rather than a narrower inferred object. The voice diagnostic receives Boolean(manualAttempt), preserving the helper existing truthiness behavior and its declared boolean input.

No source line count changes; legacy inventory positions remain unchanged. Existing console recrown suite is selected unchanged. This patch does not authorize a terminal result from diagnostic metadata alone.
